rows.grounds: object of hearing; supreme immortal essence
compound describing the nectar as the true nature of Kaula
compound qualifying the nectar as consisting of kāmakalā

items.question: What is the nature of the nectar identified with the Kaula essence?
premises: The nectar is called the true nature of Kaula.
The listener is commanded to hear about this nectar.
items.inference: The supreme nectar to be understood is the Kaula essence whose very nature is kāmakalā.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal sense of kāmakalā in this context is not fully specified by the verse alone.
items.plain_english: Hear of the nectar, the true nature of Kaula, which consists of kāmakalā.
